title: Renovation contract, warranty and payment — CAS, Kyiv
description: Renovation and construction contract with CAS: estimate, timeline, stage acceptance, 36-month warranty, payment 50/50, 50/30/20, 50/40/10 or from a 10% advance.
lead: How a renovation or construction contract with CAS Development works: what it covers, how we hand over each stage, what the warranty is and how you can pay. We will send a sample contract on request.

sections.h2: A works contract is the basis of every renovation
p: We sign renovation and construction as a works contract under Chapter 61 of the Civil Code of Ukraine: the contractor carries out the work to the client’s brief, and the client accepts and pays for the result. Everything that matters to you — scope, price, timeline and warranty — goes into the contract and its annexes before work starts.

The most common problem with renovation contracts is a vague scope: “renovate the apartment” with no list of works. That is why our contract comes with an itemised estimate of works and materials and, for renovation to a design project, the drawings.

items: Property, address, list and volume of works; the design project or drawings as an annex.
Works and materials item by item. If CAS carries out the renovation, the total stays within ±5% of the estimate.
Start date, stage schedule and handover date. Timelines start from 2 weeks, depending on the scope.
The schedule you chose: 50/50, 50/30/20, 50/40/10 or split by stages; you start with an advance from 10%. The advance and the certificate each payment is tied to are fixed in the contract.
Each stage is handed over with a signed completion certificate, so you see what is done and what you pay for.
Photo reports every 1–2 weeks; for an extra fee, an online camera on site 24/7.

36 months on completed works from the day they are accepted under the final certificate. For construction, major renovation and reconstruction, the warranty on the building follows Article 884 of the Civil Code of Ukraine and the contract. How to report a defect and how fast we fix it is set out in the contract.
What happens if deadlines or payments are missed, and how disputes are resolved.

Force majeure (Article 617 of the Civil Code) means events that directly prevent a specific obligation from being performed — for example, shelling or damage to the property. The affected party notifies the other and confirms it with a Chamber of Commerce certificate or other documents; deadlines move for as long as the event lasts. Martial law or scheduled power cuts are not force majeure by themselves — how they affect deadlines is agreed separately in the contract.
Conditions and procedure: settlement for works actually completed and materials purchased for the property (Article 849 of the Civil Code).

items.p: 50% at the start, 50% after handover and signing of the final certificate.
50% at the start, 30% after an intermediate stage is accepted under a certificate, 20% after the final certificate is signed.
50% at the start, 40% after an intermediate stage, the last 10% after the final certificate is signed.
Pay for each stage separately; start with an advance from 10%.
For companies registered in Ukraine, with closing documents. Invoicing for EU companies is being set up.

Renovation is carried out by three in-house salaried CAS crews for different levels of complexity and types of work; custom kitchens and wardrobes are made by our staff and partners. A site manager checks every stage.
Photo reports from site every 1–2 weeks; for an extra fee, a 24/7 online camera so you can see the site at any time.
The estimate guarantee applies only when CAS carries out the renovation: then the total stays within ±5% of it.

items: Can I see the contract before signing?
Yes. Leave a request and we will send a sample contract; for your property we prepare a contract with an estimate and schedule.
What is the warranty on renovation?

36 months on completed works from the day they are accepted under the final certificate. For construction and reconstruction, the warranty on the building follows Article 884 of the Civil Code of Ukraine and the contract.
On the schedule you choose: 50/50, 50/30/20, 50/40/10 or split by stages; you start with an advance from 10%. By invoice (for companies registered in Ukraine), card or cash.
Can the total grow during the renovation?
If CAS carries out the renovation, the total stays within ±5% of the approved estimate.
Three in-house salaried CAS crews for different complexity and types of work; custom kitchens and wardrobes are made by our staff and partners.
How do I follow the works from abroad?
Photo reports every 1–2 weeks and, for an extra fee, an online camera on site 24/7.
How long does a renovation take?
The timeline is fixed in the contract and starts from 2 weeks, depending on the scope.
